_comment: VOLUME background gate. Forces UseVolume=1 and sweeps how much busier than usual the tape must be (18 evaluations). VolMult is the ratio against the bar's OWN half-hour slot averaged over the last VolBaseDays completed weekday days: 1.1 means 'barely above normal', 2.0 demands a clear burst. VolBaseDays trades adaptivity for stability — 3 days follow a regime change quickly, 10 days shrug off one freak session but push Lookback to 739 bars, making this the slowest file to run. VolLookbackBars stays fixed at 3 by strategy definition. This gate is the single largest cut on trade count, so read cal_screen.json's numbers before trusting any ranking here. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker GAZP -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/cal_volume.json -out ./reports/GAZP_volume -months 24 -min-trades 20 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor
